# Backlog Grooming

## Overview

This document contains a snapshot from a backlog grooming session held on July 10, 2026. It outlines prioritized tasks, iceboxed ideas, and rejected proposals for various products, including Aurora and TeaBuddy.

## Key Details

The backlog is organized into several categories based on priority and status.

### Priority 0 (P0) Tasks

*   **Aurora:**
    *   Publish the power budget spreadsheet.
    *   Implement rejoin hardening for version 0.3.9.
    *   Create a comparison page for the SenseNode SN-400.
*   **TeaBuddy:**
    *   Release the Android v1.1 beta.
    *   Verify the fix for the cancel bug (TB-142).
    *   Conduct a box copy audit for all presets.

### Shared Icebox

*   Plant Whisperer app (ticket #47).
*   Development of a contradiction linter.
*   Implementation of an auto-refresh feature for the wiki index.

### Quick Wins

*   Add 40 extended dummy raw files for compiler stress testing.
*   Fix the forum scrape issue detailed in thread #9102.

### Stale / Rejected Items

*   The proposal to rename MeshSync to MeshSink has been rejected again.
*   The product name "KarpathyGarden" has also been rejected again.
